inputSnapshot.sourceEnetPath: 输入/LICAP350F_V1.5历史模型/稳压模块_V1.4-L1.enet
inputSnapshot.note: The named design-plan.enet is absent in the current project tree; used the current V1.4-L1 exported ENET. This distinction is recorded for review.

ratingsUsed.agingSensitivity: capacitance decrease up to 20%; ESR increase up to 100% of maximum initial ESR; modeled only as EOL sensitivity, not a claim about installed cells

workingWindowDefinitions.internal_voltage: Vint in 17.6..19.6 V; an assumed internal-stack window
workingWindowDefinitions.terminal_voltage: Vterm in 17.6..19.6 V (equivalent to 2.2..2.45 V/cell only under uniform sharing); terminal UV/OV stops discharge/charge; assumed real-terminal window

assumptions.windowThresholdStatus: Not frozen; both definitions are reported without changing the target limits or power.
assumptions.loadModel: Constant bus output/input power demand; virtual power demand only.
assumptions.converterEfficiency: 0.95 fixed assumption; converter dynamics and switching are not modeled.
assumptions.esrModel: Stack DC ESR from eight identical series cells; no wiring, connector, inductor, capacitor, or contact resistance added.
assumptions.dischargePowerEquation: Pbus/eta = (Vint - I*Rs)*I, using the smaller positive root.
assumptions.chargePowerEquation: Pbus*eta = (Vint + I*Rs)*I, using the smaller positive root.
assumptions.currentLimitStatus: Candidate only; modeled as an event if crossed and reported against the waveform.
assumptions.peakCurrentAInterpretation: peakCurrentA is the time maximum of the averaged model and excludes switching ripple; being below the 80 A candidate does not prove the switch peak current is below 80 A.
assumptions.thermalLimitations: Cell continuous-current ratings are 21 A RMS at delta-T 15 C and 34 A RMS at delta-T 40 C. Thermal capacitance/conditions are unknown; no pulse-temperature or thermal-safety claim is made. The 220 A peak rating has no duration in the cited datasheet and is not used as a pulse allowance.
assumptions.acceptanceBoundary: Numerical model result only; no MCU firmware, controller stability, hard protection, layout, or physical acceptance is implied.

summary.oneSecondCriterion: PASS iff modeled constant bus power is sustained for at least 1.0 s before the selected event; this is not system acceptance.
